source_law.text: Upon the immediate approach of an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency, making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of every other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: Yield the right-of-way.

Eight exact pinned offline commands, 480-frame synthetic saved finalizations, exact v1 Core/Lean/video positives and missing-source negatives, retained error logs and independent audits pass. These are unselected diagnostic proofs; strict v2 recipe receipts, original vehicle authority and qualifying lamp pixels, physical Native behavior and legal outcome remain unverified worker-owned work.

This authoritative disposition remains exception_pending. A separate original-capture-format saved bridge is embedded in all eight current bundles; two 480-frame CPU mock positives, six source/frame/provenance negatives and an independent receipt audit pass. The mock does not depict or establish an officer gesture.

Official_1/official_2 each have primary plus three distinct unselected Native requests. Eight pinned offline, saved bridge/finalizer positive and negative, v1 exact portable compatibility positive and negative, measurement-contract and controlled-comparison proofs pass on synthetic CPU fixtures. Official agency authority, incorporated equipment qualification, strict v2 delivery proof and Native observation remain open. Supplemental NRS 484A.480(3) review is not a frozen assignment input.
